div.div: Hit latency is two cycles: S_IDLE compares tags and presents the block-RAM address, S_HIT returns the word. cpu_ready is decoded from the state, so each request is served exactly once. Device accesses are registered on both sides (S_UNC_XFER, S_UNC_DONE), which keeps the cache off the core-to-device timing path.
